sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Fete Element (increases all stats by 100%, increases cost recovery speed by 10, Ability Power is boosted by 30 when attacking an enemy in Break) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +300

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 460-Ability-Power attack that deals magic dark damage to all enemies 5 times at success of 100 points by 300.
Only [The Great Mage] Frieren can be used as Unlocking Potential material
